body.label: Effect
body.html: Burn 1 additional Action Die. On success, deal 2 Necrotic Damage; your Harmony is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn, even on a miss.

surges.html: On a hit, suppress its ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Offering
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, the target becomes Possessed. Trigger: it attacks your Harmony. Echo: grant +1 Harmony against that attack before rolling.
